title: Hello Party
premise: A test game for developers. Everyone says hello once; then it is over.

rules.title: Your card
points: You are dealt one secret word. Only you can see it.

rules.title: Say hello
points: Type a short hello and send it. Everyone sees it on the board.
Each player says hello once. When all have, the game is over.

rules.title: Ending early
points: The Host can end the game from the Party at any time.
